New customers? Strange for a cook to
say this, but the capital has plenty
of better restaurants than this one.

rows.label: tlk70000030_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Although...I have to admit I've
had a bit of a rough time lately
and it's affecting my cooking...

rows.label: tlk70000030_01_msg0003

I still have regulars who come to eat
my food. I'm happy, but I also feel
sorry for them...

rows.label: tlk70000030_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Er...sorry. Anyway... Were you looking
to have a meal? I'll cook but I can't
really recommend anything.
